text: Ryan Lanyon, Manager, Transportation Policy and Innovation, and Chair, Interdivisional Working Group on Automated Vehicles will give a presentation on Preparing the City of Toronto for Automated Vehicles, in order to hear feedback from the Committee. The presentation will include an update on the progress of the Automated Vehicles Tactical Plan.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee deferred consideration of the item until its June 4, 2019 meeting.
